name: BlizzCon
blurb: Blizzard Entertainment's own fan convention in Anaheim, celebrating its game franchises with panels, esports and a show floor.
notes: BlizzCon 2026 ran Sept 12-13, 2026 at the Anaheim Convention Center (per the batch seed note), which already ended before the 2026-10-05 research window. The current homepage (rendered 2026-10-05) is now a post-event thank-you page ('THANKS FOR BEING PART OF BLIZZCON 2026' / 'THE ROAD HOME BEGINS') with no date, venue or announcement for a next edition anywhere in its text, nav links or JSON-LD. BlizzCon was skipped entirely in 2025, so its cadence is no longer annual/predictable; left as status active (Blizzard has not said it is ending BlizzCon) with editions left empty until a next date is announced.
